title: Add a diary entry form
body:
Add a browser interface for creating and viewing diary entries. Depends on #11 (Add Redis-backed diary API).

- R1: Show required date, title, and body fields with a Create diary action.
- R2: Submit entries through the diary API and show the returned entry in the list immediately.
- R3: Reloading the page still shows entries stored by the API. Add browser E2E tests.
